verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Semgrep AppSec Platform exposes an API for listing deployments, findings and projects. Nothing in the pack shows API versioning or a documented deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. An API for a SaaS security platform makes this a fair axis, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
